name: Override: both red Toggles and a stack
description: Starts with its back 1 in off red's wall, the Toggle arms' tips 0.5 in in front of the left Toggle. Backs the arms into the left Toggle twice (blue, then red), drives through the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5) and closes the claw on it on the way, sets it on the neutral bottom Goal, then backs into the bottom Toggle twice. Each hit is a drive that ends just short of the wall still at full speed, so the Toggle turns as the next step starts. Red has 50 points at 13.8 s and takes the Autonomous Bonus.

steps.note: out from the wall for a run-up
back toward the left Toggle, still at full speed at the end
the arms hit it: blue turns in; drive away for the next run-up
red turns in as the arms hit; onto the line through the stack and the Goal
through the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5) onto the neutral bottom Goal
let go and back out of the bite down the line, level with the bottom Toggle
back toward the bottom Toggle, still at full speed at the end
the arms hit it: blue turns in; drive away for the next run-up
the arms hit it: red turns in; drive away so it counts
